title: Ford set to challenge Tesla after big new deal with tech giant
title_zh: 福特与科技巨头达成新协议后将挑战特斯拉
summary: Doug Field spent years at Apple working on a car the company never built. When Apple shut down Project Titan in early 2024, Field moved to Ford. He's been leading the automaker's technology strategy since. On July 23, you could see exactly what he's been building toward.
summary_zh: 道格·菲尔德（Doug Field）在苹果公司工作了数年，致力于开发一款该公司从未生产过的汽车。当苹果公司于 2024 年初关闭泰坦计划时，菲尔德跳槽到了福特。此后他一直领导该汽车制造商的技术战略。 7 月 23 日，你可以清楚地看到他一直在努力实现的目标。

title: ORCL Stock Rises After-Hours On Pentagon Deal Worth Up To $7B — Why Retail Sees NOW, PLTR, MSFT And Others Benefiting Too
title_zh: ORCL 股价因五角大楼价值高达 7B 美元的交易而在盘后上涨 - 为什么零售业现在认为 PLTR、MSFT 和其他公司也受益
summary: Stocktwits retail traders said the contract could be the first of many government AI wins, with some also turning bullish on Palantir and enterprise software peers.
summary_zh: Stocktwits 零售交易员表示，这份合同可能是政府在人工智能方面赢得的众多胜利中的第一个，一些人也开始看好 Palantir 和企业软件同行。

title: Pentagon awards Oracle nearly $7 billion deal in latest software consolidation push
title_zh: 五角大楼在最新的软件整合推动中授予甲骨文近 70 亿美元的交易
summary: WASHINGTON, July 23 () - The Pentagon announced on Thursday a nearly $7 billion, up-to-10-year agreement with Oracle ‌to consolidate the department's on-premises software licenses ‌into a single contract, the latest move by the Pentagon's technology ​chief to cut costs by elim...
summary_zh: 华盛顿，7 月 23 日 () - 五角大楼周四宣布与 Oracle 达成一项价值近 70 亿美元、为期长达 10 年的协议，将国防部的本地软件许可证整合为一份合同，这是五角大楼技术负责人通过消除成本来削减成本的最新举措。

title: Has Cisco Systems (CSCO) Run Ahead Of Fair Value Following Its Webex Contact Center Deal?
title_zh: 思科系统公司 (CSCO) 在其 Webex 联络中心交易后，其公允价值是否高于公允价值？
summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) has been in focus after SuccessKPI announced a partnership to integrate its Workforce Engagement Management and intelligence tools directly into Cisco’s Webex Contact Center, creating a single cloud-native platform for hybrid human and AI contact centers.
summary_zh: 在 SuccessKPI 宣布建立合作伙伴关系，将其员工敬业度管理和智能工具直接集成到思科的 Webex 联络中心，为混合人力和人工智能联络中心创建单一云原生平台后，思科系统公司 (CSCO) 一直受到关注。
